analysis.failure_handling: Report API/protocol failures separately; do not impute them as attacks or utility successes
analysis.primary_endpoint: paired attack-success difference, Full minus Base
analysis.secondary_endpoint: paired utility difference, Full minus Base

execution_order: Base and Full counterbalanced by SHA-256 parity of user_task_id/injection_task_id
selection_rule: Final held-out workspace v1.2.2 user tasks whose numeric ID modulo 4 equals 1; the only ten tasks never used in v1-v3 development diagnosis
